extracted.stage: Early stage matrimonial proceedings, not yet costed
extracted.summary: A partner at Fischer & Achebe Legal is making a preliminary enquiry about funding for a client in matrimonial proceedings where assets are around £1,363,000, with no costs figure yet.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about possible funding for your client's matrimonial matter. To take this further we would need the amount of funding being sought and an estimate of costs to date and going forward, confirmation of the jurisdiction of the proceedings, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, and details of the assets in dispute and how they are held. Client identification details and your firm's engagement position would also be helpful. Once we have those, a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer or indication of terms.
